data.title: Add a Passed label to report cards

description.text: The school's passing mark is 75: a score of 75 and above counts as passed.
Released to production at 13:00. Someone reported slow report cards, is it my release?

checks.text: Report page errors: 1% until 12:35, then up to 9% from 12:40 (before the 13:00 release)
Errors after the 13:00 release: still 9%, no increase
Infrastructure Team note: the database server has been slow since 12:35, being handled
Automatic tests: 4 of 4 passed, including a score of exactly 75

explanation: Errors rose at 12:40, before the 13:00 release, and didn't grow afterwards; the cause is the database server. The code is also correct (>= 75), so a rollback would only undo good work.
hints: When exactly did the errors start rising? Compare that with the release time.
If the errors were there before the release and didn't grow, is this release the cause?
